description: Add a new note to a trading day — any day, traded or not; `date` is YYYY-MM-DD in the journal timezone. Days hold any number of notes, so this never overwrites: to change an existing note use journal_update_note, and for a note about one specific trade use journal_update_trade's `notes`. Returns the note with its id. Day notes in the LuxAlgo journal: https://docs.luxalgo.com/platform/workspaces/journal/notes Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

body.description: The note text (plain text or markdown).

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

date.description: The day the note belongs to, YYYY-MM-DD in the journal timezone.

name: journal_write_note
title: Write a journal note
